title: "5" * "4" is 20: * converts both text operands to numbers

source.quote: Any argument passed as a string is automatically converted into a number
source.supports: the page says 5 * 4 and "5" * "4" return the same result

derivation: Both strings are converted to numbers, 5 and 4, and 5 * 4 = 20.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says which numeric type the text becomes.
